parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: The list of device information that triggers data mapping.

sub_parameters.name: DeviceName
sub_parameters.description: The device name. You can specify up to 5 device names in a single call.

sub_parameters.name: Params
sub_parameters.description:
The device data source in the `Key:Value` JSON string format.

You can specify up to 300 key-value pairs in a single call.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.
